title: Editor

notes.empty: Start typing to create a note.
notes.title: New note

drafts.empty: Write here and it's saved as a quick note automatically.
drafts.title: New quick note

folderPlaceholder: This is a folder. Select a note to start editing.
externalConflict: This file changed elsewhere. Autosave is paused; choose how to handle your local edits.
externalDeleted: This file was deleted elsewhere. Autosave is paused; save your local edits as a copy.
savedIndexPending: File saved; the index update failed. Search results may be temporarily outdated.
conflictCopySaved: Local edits saved as a copy
conflictMerged: Merged both edits. You can undo this.
conflictMergeOverlap: Both sides changed the same lines, so they can't be merged automatically. Compare them to choose.
conflictMergeTooLarge: Too many changes to merge automatically. Compare them to choose.
loadFailedNotice: Couldn't open this note; the file on disk was not changed. {{error}}

tableEditing.appendRow: Add a row at the end
tableEditing.appendColumn: Add a column at the right

menu.headerRowFixed: The header row can't be deleted or moved
menu.lastColumnFixed: A table needs at least one column

skip.unsupported_form: This form can't be edited in the panel
skip.inline_comment: The value has a comment that editing here would lose
skip.multi_line: Multi-line values can't be edited here
skip.nested: Nested structures can't be edited here
skip.duplicate_key: This property name appears more than once
skip.unclosed: The opening --- isn't closed; fix it in source first
skip.key_exists: A property with this name already exists
skip.invalid_key: Names can't be empty, contain a colon or #, or be luna
skip.not_found: This property is gone; it may have just changed
skip.invalid_value: That value doesn't fit the type: numbers like 12 or 1.5, dates like 2026-10-04

floating.title: AI actions
floating.trigger_title: Run AI actions on the entire note
floating.ask_placeholder: Tell AI what to do, or pick an action below…
floating.followup_placeholder: Follow up to refine this result…
floating.truncated: Input too long; only the first {{count}} characters were processed

action.background_title: Hand it to the processing queue and close the panel; you get a notification when it finishes

route.server_context: Cloud · sends the selection and surrounding paragraphs
route.server_cursor: Cloud · sends the text before the cursor

context.toggle_title: Whether to send the paragraphs before and after the selection as reference (only the selection is rewritten)

floating.hint: {{toggle}} open or close · Esc stop or close · {{accept}} accept
floating.hint_no_toggle: Esc to stop or close · {{accept}} to accept
floating.no_match: No matching action; press Enter to run this instruction as is

diff.toggle_title: Click to accept or reject this change

presets.saved: Preset saved; it will be in the list next time

preflight.chunked: {{count}} characters exceed the {{limit}} limit: Summarize will digest {{chunks}} parts, then combine them
preflight.truncated: {{count}} characters exceed the {{limit}} limit: only the first {{limit}} will be processed
preflight.tail: Long preceding text: only the part nearest the cursor is used as context

pending.notice: This finished in the background and is waiting for you to land it

floating.drag_hint: Drag here to move the panel

table.fill_placeholder: What should the "{{column}}" column contain? For example: a one-line pitch based on the product name

rejected.not_a_table: The AI's answer didn't contain a complete table, so your note wasn't changed. Try rephrasing, or use Insert ▸ Convert selection to table to split by delimiters.
rejected.not_a_table_source: This isn't a table that can be filled row by row (it needs a header and at least one row).

version.title: Version history
version.restore_confirm: Restoring overwrites the current content with this version (the current content is snapshotted first).
version.emptyHint: A version is kept automatically before every save, external-change merge and AI rewrite.
version.diffIdentical: This version matches the current content
version.diffDegraded: The changed region is too large — shown as a coarse block replacement.

embed.missing: The embedded note or file can't be found

paste.readFailed: Cannot read the clipboard. Your note was not changed.
paste.saveFirst: Save the note first, then paste attachments
paste.conversionFailed: Format conversion failed; pasted as plain text
paste.previewHint: Markdown cannot fully represent this content. Review the conversion or paste plain text.
paste.firstRowHeader: Use the original first row as the header
paste.tableFillHint: Content will fill the table from the current cell. Review the affected range and expanded table; plain text goes into the current cell only.
paste.tableFillRange: Fill {{rows}} rows × {{columns}} columns starting at row {{row}}, column {{column}}.
paste.tableFillChanges: Change {{replacedCells}} existing non-empty cells; add {{addedRows}} rows and {{addedColumns}} columns.

warning.formatting_simplified: Fonts, colors and specialized layouts are simplified to Markdown. Check emphasis and structure.
warning.complex_table: Merged cells, nested or irregular tables will be simplified. Content remains; layout may change.
warning.missing_header: A blank header is added; the original first data row is preserved.
warning.images_omitted: Image descriptions are kept; remote resources are not downloaded. Use attachments to insert images.
warning.unsafe_links: Unsafe links are removed; their text is retained.

print.hint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the system print panel to export.

asset.loadFailed: Cannot load a preview for this file
asset.pdfHint: Inline PDF preview isn't supported yet — open it with an external app.
asset.binaryHint: This file type has no inline preview — open it with an external app.

table.noColumns: Couldn't find columns in the selection. Separate them with tabs, commas or two or more spaces.

writing.label: Writing modes
writing.typewriterHint: Keep the current line vertically centered while typing
writing.focusHint: Dim paragraphs other than the current one
writing.spellcheckHint: Underline misspelled words in Latin-script languages; right-click for corrections

tidyList.title: Tidy list levels
tidyList.desc: Found {{count}} lines with empty nested list chains; each will be collapsed to a single list marker. Nothing is written until you confirm.
tidyList.snapshotNote: A version snapshot is kept before writing; recover it from version history.
tidyList.nothing: Nothing to tidy: no empty nested list chains found

graphTags.panelDone: Generated {{count}} graph tags and saved them to the note
graphTags.saveFailed: Save the note first to generate graph tags

empty: Pick something on the left to write up, or just start writing — turn it into a proper note once it is ready

timecode.playFromHere: Play from this line (⌘/Ctrl-click the line does the same)

image.resize: Drag to resize, double-click to reset

conflictCopy.copyOf: This is a conflicted copy of “{{name}}” ({{source}}): the note was changed in two places at once and the sync could not merge them.
conflictCopy.keepCopyDesc: The original is saved as a version first and can be restored from Version history. This copy is then removed: {{consequence}}
conflictCopy.keepOriginalTitle: Keep the original and remove this copy?
conflictCopy.keepOriginalDesc: The original stays as it is. This copy is removed: {{consequence}}
conflictCopy.keptCopy: Replaced the original with this copy. The old text is in Version history.
conflictCopy.keptOriginal: Kept the original and removed the copy.
conflictCopy.gitMarkers: This note contains unresolved git merge conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>). Keep the parts you need and delete the markers.

templateInsert.title: Insert template
templateInsert.hint: Pick a template to insert at the cursor; its variables are filled in now. The template's properties (frontmatter) are not inserted.

wordGoal.title: Word goal for this note
wordGoal.label: Target words
wordGoal.desc: How many words this note should reach. The status bar shows “written / goal”; the goal is kept in this note’s frontmatter.
wordGoal.descCurrent: The current goal is {{goal}} words. Enter 0 to remove it.
wordGoal.invalid: Enter a whole number for the word goal (0 removes it)
wordGoal.saveFirst: This note has unsaved changes — save it before setting a goal
